---
title: "Instacart Shopping Behavior"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)

data("instacart", package = "p8105.datasets")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Dataset dimensions and variables
dim(instacart)
names(instacart)
glimpse(instacart)

# Number of unique orders, users, and products
instacart |>
  summarise(
    n_orders = n_distinct(order_id),
    n_users = n_distinct(user_id),
    n_products = n_distinct(product_id)
  )

# Purchase frequencies by department
instacart |>
  count(department, sort = TRUE) |>
  print(n = Inf)

# Order counts by hour
instacart |>
  distinct(order_id, order_hour_of_day) |>
  count(order_hour_of_day) |>
  arrange(order_hour_of_day) |>
  print(n = Inf)

# Purchase frequencies and reorder rates
instacart |>
  group_by(department) |>
  summarise(
    n_purchases = n(),
    reorder_rate = mean(reordered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_purchases)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r data-preparation, include=FALSE}
# Orders by hour
hourly_orders =
  instacart |>
  distinct(order_id, order_hour_of_day) |>
  count(order_hour_of_day, name = "n_orders") |>
  arrange(order_hour_of_day)

# Top 10 departments by purchase frequency
top_departments =
  instacart |>
  count(department, name = "n_purchases", sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

# Department-level purchase frequency and reorder rate
department_summary =
  instacart |>
  group_by(department) |>
  summarise(
    n_purchases = n(),
    reorder_rate = mean(reordered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(hourly_orders, n = Inf)

print(top_departments, n = Inf)

print(department_summary, n = Inf)
```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Shopping Activity

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = hourly_orders,
  x = ~order_hour_of_day,
  y = ~n_orders,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers",
  text = ~paste0(
    "Hour: ", order_hour_of_day, ":00",
    "<br>Orders: ", scales::comma(n_orders)
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  line = list(color = "#4599D0", width = 3),
  marker = list(size = 5)
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Hour of Day",
      tickmode = "linear",
      dtick = 2
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Number of Orders",
      separatethousands = TRUE
    )
  )
```

### Popular Departments

```{r}

plot_ly(
  data = top_departments |>
    mutate(
      department = forcats::fct_reorder(
        department, n_purchases
      )
    ),
  x = ~n_purchases,
  y = ~department,
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h",
  hovertext = ~paste0(
    department,
    "<br>Purchases: ",
    scales::comma(n_purchases)
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  marker = list(color = "#72B7DD")
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Number of Item Purchases",
      separatethousands = TRUE
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = ""),
    margin = list(l = 120)
  )
```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Reorder Patterns

```{r}

plot_ly(
  data = department_summary,
  x = ~n_purchases,
  y = ~reorder_rate,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  text = ~paste0(
    "Department: ", department,
    "<br>Purchases: ", scales::comma(n_purchases),
    "<br>Reorder Rate: ",
    scales::percent(reorder_rate, accuracy = 0.1)
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  marker = list(
    color = "#4599D0",
    size = 10,
    opacity = 0.75
  )
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Number of Item Purchases",
      separatethousands = TRUE
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Reorder Rate",
      tickformat = ".0%"
    )
  )
```
